verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe fetched an OpenAPI 3.0.3 file without authentication at /openapi/mesh-api.json, and it covers customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s on generic guessed paths don't contradict this, since the spec lives at a different documented URL. Missing for 10: the spec isn't available at standard or well-known paths, and there's no confirmation it covers the full API surface (e.g., screening or webhook schemas).
